Observed day-of-year flow climatology at HYDAT stations

Source: R/wet_station_doy.R
wet_station_doy.Rd

For each station, the mean daily flow on each day of a 365-day common year over its complete years, the same years wet_station_monthly() uses, so the daily and monthly climatologies describe one record. 29 February is folded into 28 February: in a leap year the two days are averaged before the years are. A day with no value in any complete year (at most 11 days a month can be missing in a complete year) is filled by linear interpolation from its neighbours around the year, and counted in the "filled" attribute. share is the day's part of the year's volume, so the 365 shares sum to 1.

Usage

wet_station_doy(
  stations,
  hydat = wet_hydat_path(),
  years = attr(stations, "years"),
  min_days = 20
)

Arguments

stations

Output of wet_station_select(), or any data frame with a station_number column when years is given.

hydat

Path to the HYDAT sqlite database. Defaults to tidyhydat's download location.

years

Named list, by station, of the complete years to average over; by default the "years" attribute wet_station_select() sets.

min_days

Minimum days of flow for a month to count as complete.

Value

data.frame(station_number, doy, q_m3s, share, n_years), 365 rows per station, with attribute "filled": a data frame of the station_number, doy pairs that were interpolated (zero rows when none).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# a HYDAT release pinned through wet's cache (see wet:::wet_hydat)
h <- wet:::wet_hydat("20260717")
s <- wet_station_select(h)
d <- wet_station_doy(s[s$station_number == "08EE013", ], h,
                     years = attr(s, "years")["08EE013"])
# a month's days average to its monthly mean, February aside (28 vs 28.25 days)
tapply(d$q_m3s, wet:::wet_doy_month(), mean)
} # }
